note: Single machine-readable source of truth for every public technical claim about citrate-chain. Each value is tied to source files and, where applicable, reproducible evidence. Website and marketing facts MUST be generated from this file, not hand-copied. Numbers here were measured/derived from the code at source_commit; see verification_status per claim. See verification/README.md for status definitions.

checkpoint_interval.notes: [checkpoint] interval=50, committee_size=100, quorum_threshold=67 (2/3+1 BFT committee finality, WP-W.2). These are CONFIGURED parameters of a mechanism that is specified but NOT running: the producer path that proposes checkpoints is compiled in but pinned OFF for 40204 (CHECKPOINT_VOTING_PINS), so no checkpoint is ever proposed or finalized (see deterministic_checkpoint_finality).

deterministic_checkpoint_finality.reproduction_command: python3 verification/check_claims.py  # fails if this claim says running=true unless CHECKPOINT_VOTING_PINS and CHECKPOINT_ENFORCEMENT_PINS are ON for 40204, a non-test path calls sign_checkpoint_vote(, and a node file builds NetworkMessage::CheckpointVote and broadcasts it
deterministic_checkpoint_finality.notes: Checkpoint finality is SPECIFIED, NOT RUNNING on the public testnet. The code exists behind two compiled pins in core/consensus/src/checkpoint_gadget.rs, both OFF for 40204 in this release: CHECKPOINT_VOTING_PINS (Stage 1a producer path: propose, sign, broadcast, relay) and CHECKPOINT_ENFORCEMENT_PINS (Stage 1c: a verified certificate whose (height, hash) is the node's own canonical block raises the reorg floor; node/src/finality_floor.rs). With voting OFF nothing is proposed, so no checkpoint finalizes, the reorg floor stays at 0 and the 'finalized'/'safe' RPC tags resolve to genesis. Running additionally needs a staked validator committee of at least 4. Confirmation is probabilistic. The 'finalized'/'safe' tags are served since #250: block lookups with them return GENESIS (block 0) and account-state reads with them are refused while the finalized height is behind the head; a client must not read 'finalized' = genesis as a finality signal. Do NOT publish a finality time (the old 90-100s figure assumed a running committee).

confirmation_latency.notes: Confirmation is probabilistic: a block lands every ~2s (measured) and gains weight as later blocks build on it. Checkpoint finality is specified, not running. 'depth >= 100' is a display heuristic used by the explorer, not a protocol guarantee. No end-to-end measured latency artifact is published yet.

precompiles.notes: ERRATUM (2026-10-19): the precompile set is NOT '0x0100-0x010F'. Canonical scheme (WP-B0): the EVM address IS the short name. Exposed to contract code (REVM bridge, revm_adapter.rs:678-735): the 16 PURE_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESSES (0x0107-0x0109, 0x010A-0x010F, 0x0110-0x0111, 0x0120, 0x0130, 0x0200-0x0202; mod.rs:154-171) plus the 4 AGENT_FORK_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESSES 0x0112 LORA_APPLY, 0x0113 LORA_MERGE, 0x0121 MEMORY_ANCHOR_VERIFY, 0x0122 AGENT_OPS (mod.rs:180-185), live from genesis on 40204 (agent_fork.rs:60 pins Some(0)) = 20 addresses. The hosted-inference family 0x0100-0x0106 is NOT bridged: inside the precompile range it is a reserved, always-failing address set for contract code once pba_hardening_height is active (pinned to genesis on 40204; mod.rs:214-231). 0x0104 is RETIRED (inference.rs:34; always rejects; use the 0x0108 verifier). FEATURE-GATED: 0x0130's recursive-fold CommD verifier needs the commd-fold-verify feature, which is in citrate-node's DEFAULT feature set (node/Cargo.toml:106) but off by default in citrate-execution; without it the address fails closed. 0x0108's live Halo2-KZG verifier needs the halo2-verifier feature, which is NOT in the default node build, so 0x0108 fails closed with SubstrateAbsent on default builds. contracts/addresses/40204.json lists 21 addresses (0x0100-0x0103, 0x0105-0x0111, 0x0120, 0x0200-0x0202); it omits 0x0104 (retired), 0x0130 and the four agent-fork addresses.

model_registry_precompile_flag.notes: RESOLVED in bf551422 (reroll G, #292): ModelRegistry.sol no longer hard-codes 0x1000/0x1002; requestInference routes to 0x0101 MODEL_INFERENCE through CitratePrecompiles.modelInference, the canonical address in the dispatcher and in 40204.json. The address now agrees. Separately, 0x0101 is NOT served to contract code on 40204 (the inference family is a reserved, always-failing range for the REVM bridge; see precompiles), so the helper fails closed and ModelRegistry.requestInference reverts with PrecompileUnavailable (payment included): registration is an on-chain record only. Superseded value (2026-09-24): agrees=false with constants 0x1000/0x1002.

current_testnet_sustained_tps.derivation: block_gas_limit(30,000,000) / gas_per_simple_transfer(21,000) / measured_block_time(~2s) ~= 714, rounded to ~750 for simple transfers
current_testnet_sustained_tps.reproduction_command: grep -n 'MAX_GAS_PER_BLOCK' core/sequencer/src/mempool.rs; python3 -c 'print(30_000_000/21000/2)'  # ~714; tools/citrate-bench can confirm the live figure once bench signers are funded (signs client-side via eth_sendRawTransaction)
current_testnet_sustained_tps.notes: Peak is gas-limit bound: there is NO 10,000 TPS headroom on the current testnet. A block holds at most 30M/21k = ~1428 simple transfers, and blocks land ~every 2s, so sustained simple-transfer throughput is ~750 TPS.

mainnet_target_sustained_tps.notes: Aspirational mainnet target. Requires raising the block gas limit AND faster blocks (a consensus/protocol change). NOT yet implemented; owner decided NOT to change consensus params now.

mainnet_target_ceiling_tps.notes: Aspirational mainnet ceiling, same protocol-upgrade dependency as the sustained target.

executor_parallel_ceiling.notes: SEPARATE, HIGHER metric: the executor's in-memory parallel-execution throughput (not end-to-end network TPS, which is RPC/signature/gas-limit bound and far lower). In-process microbench via core/execution/benches/tps_parallel.rs; no committed artifact yet.

network_tps.notes: HONEST SPLIT (owner decision 2026-09-24). Public surfaces must distinguish: (1) current testnet ~750 TPS sustained for simple transfers, derived from the 30M block gas limit / 21k gas per transfer / ~2s block time and gas-limit bound (no 10k headroom); (2) mainnet targets of 5000 sustained / 10000 ceiling, which are target-pending-protocol-upgrade (require a higher gas limit + faster blocks, a consensus change not yet done); (3) the executor's in-memory parallel throughput, a separate and higher figure. The previously cited artifacts benchmarks/benchmark_2026_03_20.md and parallel_tps_verified_2026_04_21.md DO NOT EXIST; the old flat 5000/10000 'network baseline' has been replaced by this split. The deprecated tests/load benchmark_suite.rs must not be used for release claims; the canonical live harness is tools/citrate-bench.

evm_revm.notes: EVM execution via revm pinned to exact version =10 (default-features off; std + serde). Adapter in src/revm_adapter.rs.

consensus_ghostdag.notes: GhostDAG (Kaspa-family) blue-set consensus with k=18 and strict VRF proof checks (strict_vrf=true). Current topology: the public testnet runs a SINGLE block producer operated by Citrate (one producer address across a 51-block live sample on 2026-09-25; ValidatorRegistry activeSet() has 1 member). Stake-gated proposer eligibility is staged: OFF by default, enabled when CITRATE_VALIDATOR_REGISTRY is set (CITRATE_VALIDATOR_ACTIVATION_HEIGHT is optional and defaults to 0; node/src/main.rs:1443-1462). The BFT checkpoint committee (size 100, quorum 67) is the TARGET design and is not running. Any operator identity requirement is policy, not enforced by node or consensus code.

audit_status.notes: Classified Tier 1 (full external audit required before first stable v1.0.0 tag). No written external-firm audit attestation exists yet; internal adversarial re-audits and cargo-audit tripwires are in place. Prerelease tags may ship with a prerelease flag + warning.
